definitions.full: H2812. Chashabnah חֲשַׁבְנָה proper name, masculine (this and following perhaps textual error for חשׁביה(וׅ ; yet ᵐ5 Εσβανα , ᵐ5 L Ασβανα ) — a chief of the people, Nehemiah's time Neh 10:26 . See also following.
